limits: The main grapes together: at least 85%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Bordeaux appellation in Entre-Deux-Mers allowing red, white and liqueur wine. Reds use Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Cot, and whites Sémillon, Sauvignon and Muscadelle. It covers 19 communes, including Caplong and Gensac.
